subject: Vendor provisioning: delegate accounts blocked by SSO attribute filter
messages:
From: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@alpha-supplies.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble accepting supplier portal invitation - role authorization error

Hi Sofia,

We're trying to finish onboarding so our finance team can receive POs, but when my colleague tries to accept the portal invitation they get a 'You are not authorized to accept invitations' message during SSO. Screenshot attached.

We usually come in through our IdP (OneLogin) and the users are in a delegated group called "Accounts-Payable-Delegates". In your flow the user hits the SAML assertion and then a role filter removes the delegate flag.

Can you confirm whether Redwood expects a specific attribute name/value for delegated invite-acceptors? Our SSO team has asked for your metadata so they can examine attribute mapping.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help, we have a PO that needs processing today.

Best,
Anna Kowalski
Procurement Lead
Alpha Supplies

Attachments: screenshot-20260921.png (image/png)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@alpha-supplies.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invitation - role authorization error

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick note and the screenshot. Looping in Ben (sales ops) and Jordan (identity ops) so we can triage.

Short answer: Redwood's invite acceptance checks a SAML attribute we call "redwood:vendor_roles" and expects one of the values: "delegate", "admin", or "financial_contact" to allow an in-flow acceptance. If your IdP strips group claims or renames the attribute during assertion, the portal will show the authorization error you attached.

For immediate unblock: I can send a one-time fallback invite link that does an email verification instead of relying on the SAML attribute. I will also share our SAML metadata and the delegation matrix Jordan will prepare.

Can you have your IdP team send the raw SAML assertion or confirm whether group-to-attribute mapping is enabled? If not, accept via fallback link and we'll mark the account as "delegate" manually in the console and then confirm the next PO delivery.

Next steps:
- Jordan: can you please share the current metadata and the internal delegation-matrix with Anna?
- Ben: if Anna wants the fallback link, please send and log the manual provisioning action (so finance knows the account is trusted).

I'll follow up once Jordan confirms the exact attribute name mapping.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Partnerships / Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0124

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@alpha-supplies.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invitation - role authorization error

Hi Anna — attaching our SAML metadata and a short delegation-matrix (delegation-matrix.xlsx).

Technical notes for your IdP team:
- Assertion attribute name: urn:oid:1.2.840.113549.1.9.1 OR custom: redwood:vendor_roles
- Accepted values: delegate, admin, financial_contact
- Attribute format: string or multi-valued string (groups OK)
- Important: If you use an attribute filter to remove transient groups during the SP relay, ensure the redwood:vendor_roles attribute is preserved. We see OneLogin configurations where group-to-attribute mapping is applied AFTER attribute filters; reorder so mapping runs last.

Temporary workaround we've queued for Sophia/Ben: Ben, please generate a fallback invite link (email verification) and flag the account so it will not be auto-synced until IdP changes are live.

Jordan
Identity Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: delegation-matrix.xlsx, saml-metadata.xml

From: Anna Kowalski <anna.kowalski@alpha-supplies.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting supplier portal invitation - role authorization error

Hi all — thanks, Jordan and Sofia. Our IdP team updated the OneLogin mapping to expose the "redwood:vendor_roles" attribute (was previously only in group claims) and the user was able to accept the portal invite this morning using the fallback link. We uploaded the new metadata (see attachment).

Confirmed: the accept flow completed and the account shows as "delegate". We processed the PO and everything matched. If you want, we can schedule a 20-minute call to walk your ops team through our OneLogin mapping settings to prevent other vendors from hitting the same edge case.

Thanks again for the quick turnaround — Anna

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml
